sloka: दृष्ट्वा तथैव विकृतं रथं मृत्युसमन्वितम् ।सचिवा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सहसा विप्रदुद्रुवुः ।। ७.२२.१० ॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tathaiva vikṛtaṁ rathaṁ mṛtyusamanvitam ।sacivā rākṣasendrasya sahasā vipradudruvuḥ ।। 7.22.10 ॥

translations.english: In an instant, those horses, swift as thought and resembling Indra's steeds, brought Yama to the place where the battle had begun.
